CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

3. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

4. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

5. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Damage equipment used for Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

6. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   B. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming.

7. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   C. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Netball.

8. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   C. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.

9. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

10. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   C. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.

11. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.

12. Best practice when working on Middle Distance Races and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Middle Distance Races and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   D. Damage equipment used for Middle Distance Races and Montage.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Roles of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Components of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Drawing and Painting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. A — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

3. A — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. C — Red, blue, and yellow

5. A — Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. B — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. C — Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. C — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. C — The speed of the music

10. C — Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. B — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. A — Practise Middle Distance Races and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Roles of Creative Arts and Sports; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Components of Creative Arts and Sports; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Drawing and Painting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Folk Dance; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
